# Vocabulary

The controlled vocabulary of this wiki.

## Terms

[Activity](#activity) · [Functional unit](#functional-unit) · [System boundary](#system-boundary)

### Activity

- **ecoinvent (Knowledge Base)** — an ecoinvent activity dataset represents a unit process — source: ecoinvent-kb-glossary
- **Brightway (bw2data >=4)** — the name used for both processes and elementary flows — source: brightway-glossary

### Functional unit

- **ILCD (2010)** — quantified performance of a product system for use as a reference unit — source: ilcd-2010 p.42
- **ISO 14044 (2006)** — the same definition, worded as in the standard — source: iso-14044-2006

### System boundary

- **ILCD (2010)** — set of criteria specifying which unit processes are part of a product system — source: ilcd-2010 p.44
